tips.text: Level it to 30 in a Survival or Eximus-heavy mission; one player maxed it in a single Survival run.
Check the profile Mastery number if the UI shows it unmaxed after maxing, then Forma and level it again before filing a ticket.
Expect the Drifter to stop wielding it in the story after the quest; it stays in your inventory.
Players call it a fine melee, not top tier; rebuying it from Simaris rarely pays off.
